d:
Mujaphpharpur men PNG gais paiplain men risav ke karan blast ho gaya. shahar ke sadar thana kshetr ke gobrashi-dumri ilake men somvar ko karib 12 baje hadsa huaa. jismen ek yuvak ke sir ke chithre ur gae, jabki 10 se jyada log ghayal batae ja rahe hain.
Blast ki aavaj tin kilomitar tak sunaee di. sthaniy jitendr shahi ke mutabik, dhamake ke bad aaspas ke darjanon gharon aur kaee vahnon ko nuksan pahuncha hai. char manjila imarat buri tarah kshatigrast ho gaee, jabki 100 mitar ke dayre men bane kaee makanon ki khirkiyon ke shishe tute hain.
